error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
error.limited: You have made many changes in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
error.unauthorized: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again; nothing that was saved is lost.
error.purged: Guest data was deleted after the wedding as scheduled, so new guests can no longer be added.
help.guests.title: Guests and households
help.guests.body: Guests belong to households (a family, a couple, a single person). You add a guest by hand or by importing an Excel or CSV file. For each guest you choose which events they are invited to: the form asks only about those. Guests are never shown on the website.
help.import.title: Importing guests
help.import.body: Upload a table with the columns Household, Full name, Child and Age. You first see a preview with errors and duplicates; only what you confirm is saved. The file is not stored.
help.responses.title: Guest replies
help.responses.body: The overview shows who is coming to which event and who has not replied yet. You enter a reply from a guest who phoned in by hand. Counts are per person.
help.rsvp.title: Reply settings
help.rsvp.body: Choose when replies open and close, which questions the form asks and whether a guest who is not on your list may reply. The form collects diet and allergies only if you turn that on.
help.access.title: Access to management
help.access.body: Only a few administrators are allowed, and each signs in with their own e-mail. Every change of access sends a notice to the other administrators and to the backup e-mail. The guest PIN unlocks the protected parts of the website. You grant the operator consent to view data explicitly, with a reason and for a limited time.
help.data.title: Data and deletion
help.data.body: The export gives you all guest and reply data in a spreadsheet. Deleting the website cannot be undone by you; the data is erased permanently only after a grace period.
list.intro: The list of households and guests who should reply. You edit replies and invitations on each household.
list.empty: Nobody is here yet. Add the first household or upload a list from Excel.
list.search: Search for a guest or household
list.groupStats: Households: {households}, guests: {guests}. Attending: {attending}, not attending: {declined}, no reply: {pending}.
list.inviteCopyLabel: Copy the personal link for household {name}
list.enterLabel: Enter a reply for the household {name}
list.inviteReset: The personal link has been replaced. The new one is shown with the household below; the old one no longer works.
list.bulkIntro: Did you add a new event or want to invite everyone at once? Invite all guests in one step, then adjust individual guests on their household.
list.bulkRemoveQuestion: Withdraw all invitations to {event}? Guests’ replies to it will stop being shown.
list.bulkGroupIntro: Selected group: {group}. Only guests in this group are affected, everyone else stays as they are.
list.bulkGroupRemoveQuestion: Withdraw invitations to {event} for group {group}? Their replies to it will stop being shown.
list.importIntro: Do you have a guest list in Excel or CSV? Upload it: you see a preview first and only what you confirm is saved.
list.exportIntro: A spreadsheet for printing, catering or your own records. One row per person with a column for every event and question.
export.healthHint: Diet and allergies are health data. Tick this only if you really need them (for catering, for example); every release is recorded.
editor.title: Edit household
editor.label: Household name
editor.labelHint: For you only, for example “The Novak family”. Guests never see it.
editor.tagsHint: Optional, separate with commas, for example “Bride’s family, Colleagues”. You can filter guests and invite them to events by group. Guests never see them.
editor.noteHint: For you only, for example “grandmother is invited too”.
editor.name: Full name
editor.ageHint: Optional, a whole number up to 17.
editor.noEvents: There are no events to invite guests to yet.
editor.noEventsLink: Add them in the website editor.
editor.answeredNote: This household has already replied. Removing a guest also deletes their reply.
editor.deleteQuestion: Delete the whole household including its guests and their reply? This cannot be undone.
editor.inviteResetQuestion: Replace this household’s personal link? The old link and any printed QR code will stop working; the new one is in the guest list. Unsaved changes in this form will be discarded.
editor.error.name: Enter the guest’s name.
editor.error.age: Enter the age as a whole number from 0 to 17, or leave the field empty.
editor.error.tags: Use at most 10 groups, each up to 40 characters.
editor.error.fix: Please fix the marked fields. Nothing has been saved yet.
editor.error.noGuest: A household needs at least one guest.
editor.error.limit: You have reached the maximum number of guests for one website. Remove some guests first.
editor.error.notFound: We no longer have this household; it may have been deleted in the meantime. Go back to the list.
editor.error.generic: The household could not be saved. What you entered is still in the form; please try again.
cards.title: QR cards
cards.intro: Each household has its own link. A guest scans the QR code and the site opens in their language, straight at their household’s reply form, no name search needed. Print the cards and put them in the invitations.
cards.unpublished: Personal links work once the site is published. Publish your site and come back here.
cards.empty: There are no households in this selection.
cards.qrLabel: QR code with the personal link for household {name}
import.title: Import guests
import.intro: Upload a list from Excel or CSV. You see a preview before anything is saved.
import.choose.title: 1. Choose a file
import.choose.intro: The first row of the table must be a header. We recognise columns by name, in Czech or English, in any order.
import.choose.col1: Full name (required; two columns First name and Last name also work)
import.choose.col2: Household (optional): guests with the same name end up in one household
import.choose.col4: Age (optional): a number up to 17 for children
import.choose.fileHint: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, at most {size} MB and {rows} rows. Save the old .xls format as .xlsx.
import.error.noFile: Choose the file you want to upload.
import.error.nothing: There is nothing to import: every row has an error or is a duplicate.
import.error.limit: The import would exceed the maximum number of guests for one website. Shorten the list or remove some guests first.
import.fail.too_large: The file is too large. At most 1 MB can be uploaded.
import.fail.unsupported_format: We cannot read this format. Save the table as Excel (.xlsx) or CSV.
import.fail.unreadable: The file could not be read. Check that it is not damaged or password-protected.
import.fail.unpacked_too_large: The file turned out to be unreasonably large when unpacked, so we do not read it.
import.fail.empty: There are no guests in the file. There must be at least one row below the header.
import.fail.no_name_column: We did not find a name column. The first row must be a header, for example “Full name”.
import.fail.too_many_rows: The file has too many rows (at most 1,000). Split it into several files.
import.preview.title: 2. Check the preview
import.preview.summary: Rows in the file: {rows}. To import: {importable}. With errors: {errors}. Duplicates: {duplicates}.
import.preview.errorsNote: Rows with errors are not imported. Fix them in the file and upload it again, or add them by hand after the import.
import.preview.duplicates: Import duplicates too (guests who are already on the list or appear twice in the file)
import.preview.tableLabel: Preview of the rows to import
import.col.name: Name
import.problem.household_too_long: The household name is too long
import.problem.age_invalid: The age must be a number from 0 to 17 for a child
import.problem.child_invalid: The Child column should say yes or no
import.problem.household_too_big: The household has more than 20 guests
import.invite.title: Invitations to events
import.invite.intro: Imported guests are invited to the events you select. You can adjust this later on each household.
import.done.title: 3. Done
responses.intro: Who is coming, who is not and who has not replied yet. You enter the reply of a guest who phoned yourself.
responses.noEvents: There are no events yet for guests to reply to.
responses.editLabel: Edit the reply of the household {name}
responses.unlistedHint: These guests replied on their own although they are not on your list. To edit their reply, add them to the guest list first.
entry.title: Enter a reply
entry.intro: Did the guest reply by phone or in person? Enter their reply for them. Household: {names}.
entry.noEvents: This guest is not invited to any event that takes replies.
entry.name: Full name
entry.transportOffer: Offers free seats in a car
entry.note: The reply of the household {name} replaces any earlier reply. No e-mail confirmation is sent for a reply you enter by hand.
entry.error.name: Enter a name.
entry.error.age: Enter the child’s age as a whole number from 0 to 17.
entry.error.invalid: This value cannot be saved. Please check it.
entry.error.choice: Choose one of the offered options.
entry.error.fix: Please fix the marked fields. Nothing has been saved yet.
entry.error.generic: The reply could not be saved. What you entered is still in the form; please try again.
rsvp.title: Reply settings
rsvp.intro: When and to what guests can reply.
rsvp.window.title: Opening and closing
rsvp.window.intro: Time is entered in the wedding’s time zone ({zone}). Leave the fields empty if you do not want to limit replies.
rsvp.nowHint: The buttons only fill in the fields; it takes effect once you save.
rsvp.who.title: Who can reply
rsvp.unlisted: Allow guests who are not on the list to reply
rsvp.unlisted.hint: The guest enters themselves and replies to all events that take replies. You see their reply in the overview.
rsvp.email: Offer guests a confirmation by e-mail
rsvp.notify.hint: Each new or changed reply sends the administrators a short e-mail with names and attendance. Dietary and allergy details are never in it, you will find them in the management.
rsvp.email.hint: A guest may enter an e-mail address to receive a summary of their reply. The address is not stored in the guest list and is erased after the wedding.
rsvp.builtin.title: Questions in the form
rsvp.builtin.intro: Attendance at invited events is always asked. Turn the other questions on as you need.
rsvp.q.plus_one: A guest may bring a plus one
rsvp.q.plus_one.hint: One plus one per household, entered by name.
rsvp.q.children.hint: A child is entered with name and age.
rsvp.q.diet.hint: Health data: stored separately and erased 30 days after the wedding. Turn on only if you really need them.
rsvp.q.lodging.hint: Needs accommodation, has their own, not sure.
rsvp.q.transport.hint: Needs a ride, travels on their own, offers seats in a car.
rsvp.custom.title: Your own questions
rsvp.custom.intro: Up to ten questions of your own: free text, a choice of options, or yes and no. You can limit them to guests who attend a chosen event.
rsvp.custom.label: Question text
rsvp.custom.eventHint: Only a guest who says they are coming to the chosen event sees the question.
rsvp.custom.removeNote: Removing a question also removes its answers from the overview and the export.
rsvp.error.pair: Fill in both date and time, or leave both empty.
rsvp.error.date: Enter a valid date and time.
rsvp.error.period: Closing must be later than opening.
rsvp.error.label: Fill in the question text in at least one language.
rsvp.error.options: A choice needs at least two options.
rsvp.error.optionLabel: Every option needs text in at least one language.
rsvp.error.fix: Please fix the marked places. Nothing has been saved yet.
rsvp.error.invalid: The settings could not be saved; please check them.
access.intro: Who may manage the website, how they sign in and who may view your guests’ data.
access.saved: The change is saved and we sent a notice to the other administrators and to the backup e-mail.
access.admins.title: Administrators
access.admins.intro: An administrator signs in with their own e-mail and gets a code in their inbox. Every administrator can edit the website and sees guest data.
access.admins.removeQuestion: Remove the administrator {email}? All their sessions end immediately.
access.admins.emailHint: The new administrator gets an e-mail saying they were added. The other administrators and the backup address get a notice.
access.admins.addQuestion: Add the administrator {email}? They will be able to edit the website and see guest data.
access.admins.fullNote: You have reached the maximum number of administrators. To add another one, remove someone first.
access.admins.error.email: Enter a valid e-mail address, for example eva@example.com.
access.admins.error.exists: This e-mail is already among the administrators.
access.admins.error.full: You have reached the maximum number of administrators.
access.admins.error.self: You cannot remove yourself. Ask another administrator.
access.backup.title: Backup e-mail
access.backup.intro: The backup address receives notices about PIN sign-ins, PIN changes and changes of access. It should belong to someone you trust.
access.backup.unconfirmed: Nobody has confirmed this address yet, so we send no notices about sign-ins or access changes to it. The address owner received only one neutral message.
access.backup.question: Change the backup e-mail to {email}? The old and new addresses and the administrators get a notice.
access.pin.title: PIN
access.pin.intro: The management PIN allows signing in without e-mail. The guest PIN unlocks the protected parts of the website. They must be different, at least six digits and not trivial (111111, 123456).
access.pin.admin.title: Management PIN
access.pin.admin.intro: Signing in to management without waiting for an e-mail. We notify the backup e-mail of every PIN sign-in.
access.pin.guest.title: Guest PIN
access.pin.guest.intro: Guests receive it with the invitation. It unlocks the account number, the private venue and other protected parts of the website.
access.pin.hint: Six to twelve digits. Changing the PIN signs out the other devices.
access.pin.saved: The PIN is saved. We sent a notice to the backup e-mail.
access.pin.error.format: The PIN must be six to eight digits and nothing else.
access.pin.error.trivial: This PIN is too easy (for example 111111 or 123456). Choose another one.
access.pin.error.same: The management PIN and the guest PIN must be different.
access.pin.toggle.title: Protected parts of the website
access.pin.toggle.intro: While the PIN is on, the account number, the private venue and other protected parts are shown to guests only after they enter it. Turning the PIN off signs guests out at once.
access.pin.toggle.offQuestion: Turn the guest PIN off? Guests will not be able to enter it and unlocked parts will lock again.
access.pin.toggle.offQuestionLocked: Turn off the guest PIN? The site is locked: turning the PIN off opens the whole site to anyone who knows its address.
access.lock.title: Password for the whole site
access.lock.on: The site is locked: without the guest PIN nobody sees anything but your names.
access.lock.off: The site is open: the PIN protects only sensitive parts (account number, private places).
access.lock.intro: A locked site opens only after entering the guest PIN. Guests with a personal link or the QR code from the invitation get in without the PIN. You can lock the site only with the guest PIN turned on.
access.lock.needsPin: The guest PIN is turned off, so the site is open for now. Turn the PIN on and the lock applies.
access.lock.onQuestion: Lock the whole site? Guests without the PIN or a personal link will see only your names and a PIN field.
access.lock.error.pin: You can lock the site only with the guest PIN turned on. Set and turn on the guest PIN first.
access.pin.enabledNow: The guest PIN is now on.
access.pin.disabledNow: The guest PIN is now off.
access.announce.title: Printable PDF announcement
access.announce.intro: A page with the website address, a QR code and the guest PIN that you can print or enclose with the invitation. If the website has a public photo gallery link, a second QR code leads there.
access.announce.pinHint: The PIN is never stored in readable form, so please type it again. Only the correct PIN gets into the PDF; without it the announcement has no PIN.
access.announce.unpublished: The PDF with the website address can be downloaded once the website is published.
access.consent.title: Operator consent to view data
access.consent.intro: The service operator does not see your guests’ names or replies. If you need help and it is necessary, you can allow them to look: explicitly, with a reason and for a limited time. Every view is recorded and you get an e-mail about it.
access.consent.none: No consent is granted. The operator has no access to guest data.
access.consent.revokeQuestion: Withdraw the consent? The operator then immediately loses access to guest data.
access.consent.reasonHint: Why the operator should look, for example “I cannot import my list”. Do not write guest names here.
access.consent.grantQuestion: Allow the operator to view guest data for {n} days? The other administrators and the backup address get a notice.
access.consent.error.reason: Briefly write the reason, a few words at least.
access.consent.noViews: The operator has not looked at your guests’ data yet.
access.consent.denied: an attempt to view without consent was refused
data.intro: Export your data and delete the website.
data.export.title: Download all data
data.export.intro: Before you delete anything, download your guests and their replies. After deletion you will not have them.
data.delete.title: Delete the website
data.delete.warning: Deleting the website cannot be undone by yourselves.
data.delete.what1: The website stops being public at once and all management sessions end.
data.delete.what2: The data is erased permanently after {days} days. Until then the website can be restored on your request; after that it cannot.
data.delete.what3: We send a notice about the deletion to the other administrators and to the backup e-mail.
data.delete.error.word: Type exactly the word shown above the field.
